list.title: Maintenance
list.subtitle: Monthly hour quotas for maintenance clients
list.emptyHint: Create a contract with a monthly hour quota, then log the work you do. The client can follow their remaining quota through a private link.

recap.byCategoryHint: Work logged this month, by category
recap.noWork: No work logged this month yet.
recap.trend: Hours available vs used, last 6 months
recap.trendHint: Available = quota + carried over + adjustments, across all contracts

contractForm.description: Monthly hour quota for a client, optionally tied to one of their projects.

policyHint.bank: Unused hours go to the Development Balance and can be spent on new features before they expire.
policyHint.rollover: Unused hours are added to next month's quota.
policyHint.expire: Unused hours are gone at the end of the month.

contractForm.name: Contract name
contractForm.quotaChangeHint: A new quota applies from next month (and to this month only while nothing has been logged or adjusted yet). Use "Adjust quota" to change this month.
contractForm.statusHint: Paused and ended contracts don't get a quota for new months.
contractForm.capHint: Leftover beyond this expires. Default 3× the monthly quota; empty = no cap.
contractForm.expiryHint: Unused balance expires after this. Empty = never.
contractForm.overageHint: Shown next to hours worked beyond the quota.

logForm.featureDescription: Feature "{title}" · paid from the development balance
logForm.quotaDescription: Counts against the quota of the month it was done in
logForm.detailsPlaceholder: What was changed, for whom, any follow-up...
logForm.showToClientHint: Untick for internal work the client shouldn't see listed (the hours still count).

detail.noQuotaContract: No quota this month — the contract is {status}.
detail.noMonths: No months yet — the contract hasn't started.
detail.atMonthEnd: At month end, unused hours will
detail.featuresIntro: New features paid from the development balance ({hours} available). Approving reserves the estimate.
detail.showLogs: Show {n} work log | Show {n} work logs
detail.hideLogs: Hide {n} work log | Hide {n} work logs
detail.balanceIntro: Unused quota moved here at month end, spent on new features oldest-expiry first.
detail.balanceExpiry: Hours expire {n} months after the month they came from.
detail.noMovements: No movements yet. Unused hours arrive here when a month closes.
detail.noMovementsNotBank: No movements yet. Unused hours arrive here when a month closes (if the month is set to move them here).
detail.shareDescription: The client sees this month's quota, the work done, the development balance and features. No login needed.
detail.hiddenNotShown: Hidden work logs and features aren't shown to the client.
detail.noLink: There's no active link for this contract.

featureModal.description: Built with hours from the development balance ({hours} available).
featureModal.fixedHint: Fixed after approval — it's what was reserved.
featureModal.overBalance: More than the current balance — the difference would be billable unless the balance grows first.

detail.adjustPeriodHint: Applies to this month only; the contract default stays the same.
detail.adjustBalanceHint: Top-ups expire like month leftovers do.

confirm.deleteContract: Delete "{name}"? Its months, work logs and development balance are deleted too, and the client's link stops working.
confirm.revoke: Revoke this link? The client can no longer open it. A new link can be created any time.
confirm.approve: Approve "{title}"? {estimate} will be reserved from the development balance ({balance} available).
confirm.approveShort: The balance ({balance}) doesn't cover the estimate ({estimate}). Approve anyway? {balance} is reserved now; hours beyond what the balance holds when the feature is finished are marked billable.
confirm.complete: Mark "{title}" done? {used} was used; the unused {unused} goes back to the balance.
confirm.cancel: Cancel "{title}"? Hours already logged ({used}) stay spent; the rest of the reservation goes back to the balance.
